notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.notes:
[p]Rocket Automashapes version 1.2 is out now with the following changes:[/p][list][*][p]Added new levels for a total of 50![/p][/*][*][p]Added new machines for the new levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new achievement for completing 50 levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor revisions to level 23 to better demonstrate the Divider's function.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for maximizing the window in windowed mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for resizing the game window to fixed resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the level selection screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to make setting the Filter's product and the Filter's sorting direction simpler.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in the shape exploding option in the pause menu that occasionally spawned two shapes initially.[/p][/*][*][p]Various other minor improvements and bug fixes.


The new level selection screen groups levels making it easier to navigate between unlocked levels when multiple are available at once.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630808/a42925458c33e4804518f7b633b7fa5e335bca0e.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes: [p]Rocket Automashapes version 1.1 is out now with the following changes:[/p][list][*][p]Added 5 new levels and a new machine.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor revisions to levels 12, 21, 22, 23, 24, and 25.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Alt+Tab problems.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a zoom feature which can be controlled using scrollbars, arrow keys, or moving the cursor to the screen's edge.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the maximum fast-forward speed to 9 times the default.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated save file locations to keep Steam user saves separated on the same Windows profile.[/p][/*][*][p]Made the sorting direction for the Alternator easier to identify.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new shape exploding option to the pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Various other minor improvements.[/p][/*][/list]
